title: Lymphedema treatment (lymphatic drainage, pressotherapy)
what: The treatment reduces the swelling that builds up in an arm or leg. It uses gentle massage, bandaging, compression garments and a machine that squeezes the limb.
why: For lasting swelling of an arm or leg, for example after lymph nodes were removed or after radiation therapy.
duration: a session usually takes 30 to 60 minutes, a course takes several weeks, then upkeep at home
tell_doctor: If you have had blood clots in the veins
Heart and kidney disease, swelling all over the body
If there are wounds, inflammation or infection on the skin

prepare.title: Exam
prepare.text: Before treatment the doctor examines the limb and sometimes orders a vein ultrasound.

prepare.title: Skin
prepare.text: Keep your skin clean and moisturized - this protects against inflammation.

prepare.title: Clothing
prepare.text: Loose clothes, so bandaging your arm or leg is easy.

bring: A compression sleeve or stocking, if you already have one
steps: The specialist measures the size of your arm or leg
Does a gentle lymphatic drainage massage
Sometimes a machine cuff is put on that squeezes the limb in turn
Your arm or leg is bandaged or a compression garment is put on
You are taught skin care and exercises
Later, everyday compression garments are fitted
feel: The massage is very gentle, not painful
The machine cuff squeezes noticeably, but should not cause pain
The bandages feel unusual and warm at first
after: Wear the compression as prescribed - without it the swelling comes back
Protect your skin from cuts, bites and burns
Move your arm or leg and do the exercises
red_flags: The limb is red, hot and you have a fever - call your doctor
Sudden pain and swelling in the leg or arm
Sudden shortness of breath or chest pain - call your local emergency number
Fingers that are numb or blue under the bandage - take the bandage off and call

faq.q: Will the swelling go away completely?
faq.a: Often it can be reduced a lot. But the treatment has to be kept up for life.

faq.q: Can I do massage at home?
faq.a: Yes, if the specialist taught you. Plain strong massage can do harm.

reminders.text: Swelling treatment today. Take your compression garment and wear loose clothing.
